quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Dear colleagues, from 1 October, parking permits for the north lot will be issued through the online portal instead of the front desk. Existing permits stay valid until 31 December. Please register your vehicle by 15 November to avoid a temporary block on entry; the portal is open around the clock, and the front desk can help anyone who has trouble logging in. Thank you for your patience while we make the change.
options: Why the Company Is Changing Its Vehicle Rules
Front Desk Help with Login Problems
Parking Lots Closing Before the Year Ends
New Online System for Parking Permits
quests.correctAnswer: New Online System for Parking Permits
quests.hint: Imagine the subject line of this email. What would tell a colleague the essential news?
quests.explanation: The deadline and the front-desk help are details in an announcement about a changed process. The message is not about closing lots and never explains the company's reasons.
quests.whyThisTitle: The permits moving online, with the deadlines and support that follow, all belong to one change.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Notice to residents of Birch Court: water will be turned off on Thursday between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. while workers replace an old pipe; we recommend filling containers with water the night before. Please do not run the washing machine or dishwasher before the supply returns, as air in the pipes can damage them. Water may look cloudy for an hour afterward; this is harmless.
options: Replacing an Old Pipe in the Neighborhood
What to Expect During Thursday's Water Shutoff
quests.correctAnswer: What to Expect During Thursday's Water Shutoff
quests.hint: Ask what a resident needs from this notice, before and after the work.
quests.explanation: The pipe repair explains why it happens, and the cloudy water is one aftermath. The notice's job is to prepare residents for the whole shutoff period.
quests.whyThisTitle: This choice covers the timing, the advice to prepare, and the aftereffects.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Welcome to Introduction to Statistics. Over the term, you will meet twice a week for lectures and once for a lab. Grades come from three parts: weekly problem sets, a midterm, and a final project done in pairs. Late problem sets lose ten percent per day, but your lowest two scores are dropped. Office hours are Tuesdays at four, and I encourage you to come with questions before you feel stuck.
options: Why Statistics Is Difficult for Most Beginners
How the Statistics Course Is Organized
quests.correctAnswer: How the Statistics Course Is Organized
quests.hint: Look at how many different parts of the course are described.
quests.explanation: Late penalties and office hours are two parts of the overview. The message describes the structure of the whole course, and never says it is hard.
quests.whyThisTitle: Meetings, grading, deadlines, and help all describe how the course works.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: The Harbor Museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 17:00, and closes on Mondays. Tickets cost twelve euros, with reductions for students, and children under six enter free. Audio guides are available in five languages at the entrance for a small deposit. The last entry is at 16:00, and the café on the top floor remains open an hour after the galleries close.
options: Visitor Information for the Harbor Museum
Ticket Prices for Students and Young Children
A Café with a View of the Harbor
quests.correctAnswer: Visitor Information for the Harbor Museum
quests.hint: This text would sit on a visitor sheet. What would it be called?
quests.explanation: Tickets, guides, and the café each cover one piece of the information. Nothing is said about the view, and the passage gives the practical details a visitor needs.
quests.whyThisTitle: Hours, prices, guides, and the café are all facts for people planning a visit.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Because of roof repairs, the North Branch Library will be closed from 3 March until the end of April. During that time, members may borrow and return books at the Central Library or the mobile van, which will park outside the community center every Wednesday afternoon. Late fees will not be charged for items due while the branch is closed. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
options: Wednesday Visits from the Mobile Van
Where to Borrow Books While the North Branch Is Closed
Roof Repairs at the North Branch
quests.correctAnswer: Where to Borrow Books While the North Branch Is Closed
quests.hint: Ask what members will want to know after reading the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The repairs explain the closure, and the van and fees are parts of the alternative arrangements. The notice mainly tells members what to do in the meantime.
quests.whyThisTitle: The best title focuses on the alternatives offered during the closure, which is the notice's purpose.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Hi Priya, I'm sorry to ask, but I need to move Friday's client meeting. The client's flight has been delayed, so they will not arrive before three. Could we start at four instead? If that doesn't work for you, Monday morning is open. I have already booked the small conference room for both times, so we can keep whichever suits everyone. Let me know by tomorrow noon, please, so I can confirm with the client.
options: Asking to Reschedule a Client Meeting
Booking a Conference Room for Two Different Times
A Delayed Flight for a Client
quests.correctAnswer: Asking to Reschedule a Client Meeting
quests.hint: What is the writer asking Priya to do?
quests.explanation: The flight explains the request, and the conference room is a supporting arrangement. The email exists to ask for a change of time and get an answer.
quests.whyThisTitle: It names the request that the reasons, options, and deadline all support.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Thank you for contacting us about your damaged lamp. We are sorry it arrived in poor condition. To receive a refund or replacement, please send us a photo of the damage and your order number. You do not need to return the lamp. Once we receive the photo, we will process your choice within three working days, and you will get a confirmation email.
options: How to Get a Refund for a Damaged Lamp
quests.correctAnswer: How to Get a Refund for a Damaged Lamp
quests.hint: What does the customer need to do, and what will the company do?
quests.explanation: Returning items and shipping photos concern different situations. The reply is about the process for this particular damaged item.
quests.whyThisTitle: The title matches the steps the customer must take and what the company promises.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Banks never ask customers to share their full PIN or move money to a 'safe account' over the phone. Yet many people receive calls from someone claiming to be from their bank, warning that their account is at risk and urging them to act quickly. The pressure is part of the trick. If you receive such a call, hang up, wait a few minutes, and call the number printed on your card.
options: Recognizing and Handling Fake Bank Calls
Using the Number Printed on Your Card
quests.correctAnswer: Recognizing and Handling Fake Bank Calls
quests.hint: Notice that the passage both describes a threat and advises a response.
quests.explanation: Each distractor is one piece of advice or explanation. The full message is about identifying the false calls and what to do about them.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title combines what the scam looks like with the recommended response.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Starting next week, the Riverside Recreation Center will change its swimming hours. Lap swimming moves to early mornings and evenings, from 6:00 to 8:00 and 6:00 to 9:00, so the pool can host lessons for children in the afternoon. Family swim will continue on weekends. Members who prefer to swim at midday may use the smaller pool at the Elm Street branch on presentation of their card.
options: Using the Elm Street Pool at Midday
New Pool Hours at the Recreation Center
Swimming Lessons for Children in the Afternoon
quests.correctAnswer: New Pool Hours at the Recreation Center
quests.hint: What is the announcement's main news, and what are the extras?
quests.explanation: Afternoon lessons, the Elm Street pool, and family swim are all details of the schedule change. The announcement's core is that the hours are changing.
quests.whyThisTitle: The timing changes, their reason, and the alternatives all fall under the new pool hours.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Green Valley Garden Center is hiring seasonal staff for spring. Duties include watering plants, helping customers carry purchases, and stocking shelves. No experience is needed; we will teach you plant names. Shifts run 8 to 4, and weekends are required. Staff receive a discount on plants. To apply, bring a short note about yourself to the front desk.
options: Seasonal Jobs at a Garden Center
Learning Plant Names on the Job
quests.correctAnswer: Seasonal Jobs at a Garden Center
quests.hint: What kind of text is this, and what is it offering?
quests.explanation: The discount, training, and weekend requirement are each one detail of the job. The notice as a whole advertises the position.
quests.whyThisTitle: This choice names the opportunity, and every detail helps a reader decide whether to apply.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: The city weather office has issued a heat warning for Wednesday through Friday, with temperatures expected to reach 38 degrees. Residents are urged to drink water regularly, avoid outdoor work between noon and 4 p.m., and check on elderly neighbors. Libraries and community centers will open as cooling spaces during the afternoon. Never leave children or pets in parked cars, even for a few minutes.
options: Staying Safe During a Heat Warning
quests.correctAnswer: Staying Safe During a Heat Warning
quests.hint: The forecast is one part of this message. What is the rest for?
quests.explanation: Cooling spaces, neighbor checks, and temperatures are single items. The warning gathers several pieces of advice for staying safe in the heat.
quests.whyThisTitle: The advice about water, timing, neighbors, and cooling spaces all serves safety in hot weather.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Dear Ms. Grant, I am writing to ask whether I could have three extra days for the history essay. Last week I was in hospital with a broken arm, and I could not write until Monday. I have finished the research and outlined the essay, so I only need time to write the final version. I can send my outline today if that would help. Thank you for considering my request.
options: Requesting More Time for an Essay
Sending an Outline to a Teacher
Recovering from a Broken Arm at Home
Finishing Research for a History Class
quests.correctAnswer: Requesting More Time for an Essay
quests.hint: What is the writer's goal, and how does each detail serve it?
quests.explanation: The injury, the outline, and the research are all reasons or evidence. The email is a request for extra time.
quests.whyThisTitle: The best title names the request that the injury, progress, and offer to send an outline support.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Two mobile plans looked almost identical on the shop's price list. Plan A costs less each month but limits data to five gigabytes; Plan B costs eight dollars more with unlimited data. For customers who mostly use Wi-Fi at home and work, Plan A is enough; those who stream video on the bus, however, would exceed the limit within days and pay extra charges. The better plan depends on where and how the phone is used.
options: Extra Charges for Exceeding Data Limits
Choosing a Mobile Plan That Fits Your Habits
quests.correctAnswer: Choosing a Mobile Plan That Fits Your Habits
quests.hint: Look at how the last sentence sums up the message. What does it say the better plan depends on?
quests.explanation: Unlimited data and extra charges relate to one plan each. The passage compares both to teach how to choose.
quests.whyThisTitle: It reflects the guidance that the right plan depends on how the customer uses the phone.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Summary of Tuesday's team meeting: the group agreed to move the product launch from May to June because testing is not finished. Maya will update the schedule and inform the marketing department by Friday. Ben raised concerns about the budget, and it was decided to review costs at the next meeting. The next meeting is Tuesday at ten.
quests.correctAnswer: Tuesday's Meeting Decisions
quests.hint: Which title would suit a summary that lists several outcomes?
quests.explanation: The delay, the budget, and the next meeting are all included in the summary. Only one title covers everything that was agreed.
quests.whyThisTitle: The title covers the launch date, the tasks assigned, and the budget review together.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: I never planned to write about gardening. Last spring I planted twelve tomato seedlings on a balcony, and nine died. The survivors taught me more than any book: they wanted more sun than I thought, less water than I gave, and bigger pots. Below are the notes I wish I had read before I started, along with the three mistakes I will not repeat.
options: Growing Tomatoes in Small Spaces at Home
A Guide to Choosing Bigger Pots for Your Plants
Reading Gardening Books Before You Plant
quests.correctAnswer: Lessons from a Balcony Garden
quests.hint: The writer promises lessons. Where do they come from?
quests.explanation: Tomatoes, books, and pots are pieces of the story. The passage introduces lessons learned through trial and failure.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title reflects the blog's promise to share what mistakes on a balcony taught the writer.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Welcome to the Alder Hotel. Breakfast is served from 7:00 to 10:00 in the garden room. Check-out is at 11:00, but we can store your luggage until evening if your flight is late. Wi-Fi is free; the password is on your key card. For taxis or tours, ask the front desk, which is staffed all night. Quiet hours begin at ten in the evening.
options: Breakfast Times in the Garden Room
quests.correctAnswer: Helpful Information for Hotel Guests
quests.hint: This text collects several practical points. What would you call the whole?
quests.explanation: Breakfast, luggage, and taxis are individual items among many. The text's function is to give guests the basic information they need during the stay.
quests.whyThisTitle: This choice covers meals, check-out, Wi-Fi, services, and quiet hours in a single guest welcome.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Eastside Youth League is looking for parent volunteers to coach teams this autumn. You do not need to be an expert; we provide a short training evening and a coaching guide. Practices are held twice a week after school, and games are on Saturdays. Last year, the league had to turn away thirty children for lack of coaches, so every volunteer makes a real difference.
quests.correctAnswer: A Call for Volunteer Coaches
quests.hint: What does the writer want readers to do?
quests.explanation: Last year's shortage is the reason, and the training is an encouragement. The notice's purpose is to recruit volunteers.
quests.whyThisTitle: The best title names the request that the reassurance about training and the shortage both support.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Before using your new kettle for the first time, fill it with water to the maximum line, boil it, and pour the water away. Repeat once; this removes any dust from manufacturing. Never fill above the maximum line or use the kettle without water. To remove limescale, boil equal parts water and vinegar, leave for an hour, and rinse well.
quests.correctAnswer: Caring for a New Kettle
quests.hint: Think of the instructions as a page in a manual. What do they cover from start to finish?
quests.explanation: Boiling first, avoiding overfilling, and cleaning limescale are each one topic. The text covers preparing and maintaining the kettle.
quests.whyThisTitle: It brings together the first-use steps, warnings, and cleaning advice.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Unfortunately, Tuesday's evening pottery class must be canceled because the teacher is ill. Your fee for that session will be carried over to the next lesson, so there is nothing you need to do. If you cannot attend the makeup class on Saturday the 14th, please reply and we will offer you a credit for next term. We hope to see you all next week.
options: What Happens After a Canceled Class
A Teacher Falling Ill Before the Lesson
quests.correctAnswer: What Happens After a Canceled Class
quests.hint: The illness is the reason. What is the email mostly about?
quests.explanation: The teacher's illness, the makeup class, and the credit are all present. The message explains how the cancellation affects students.
quests.whyThisTitle: The title gathers the fee, makeup class, and credit into what students can expect.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Dear tenants, next week a technician will visit each apartment to check the smoke alarms and heating system. The visit takes about twenty minutes, and someone over eighteen must be at home. Visits will take place between 9:00 and 5:00 on Monday to Wednesday; a card with your time slot will be posted on your door. If the time does not suit you, call the office to arrange another.
quests.correctAnswer: Safety Checks in Every Apartment
quests.hint: Ask what event is announced and what the tenants must do about it.
quests.explanation: The time slots and rescheduling are administrative details. The announcement is about the inspection visits.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title names the visits that the timing, requirements, and options all concern.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: A payslip can look confusing, but most contain the same parts. At the top is your gross pay, the amount you earned before anything is taken out. Below are deductions such as tax and pension contributions, followed by the net pay, which is what reaches your bank account. If a figure looks wrong, ask your employer's payroll department to explain it; mistakes are rare but do happen.
options: Checking for Mistakes in Your Pay
Saving for a Pension Through Your Employer
Understanding the Parts of a Payslip
quests.correctAnswer: Understanding the Parts of a Payslip
quests.hint: Follow the order of the sections described. What is the text guiding you through?
quests.explanation: Checking for mistakes is a last piece of advice, and tax and pensions are only two lines of a payslip. The text explains the structure of the whole document.
quests.whyThisTitle: This choice walks through gross pay, deductions, and net pay, which are the parts of the payslip.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Your bill this month is higher than usual because of two changes. First, the cold spell in January meant heating was on for many more hours. Second, the price per unit of electricity rose by six percent on February 1. Your average daily use has actually stayed the same as last year. If you would like to spread the cost, you can request a payment plan through your online account.
options: Reasons for a Higher Electricity Bill This Month
How to Choose a Payment Plan
Heating Your Home in Cold Weather
quests.correctAnswer: Reasons for a Higher Electricity Bill This Month
quests.hint: Ask which title includes both causes given in the passage.
quests.explanation: Payment plans, prices, and heating are details inside the explanation. The bill is higher for two reasons, and the message is about those reasons.
quests.whyThisTitle: The best title explains the higher amount through the weather and the price increase together.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: This month at Willow Primary: Sports Day takes place on the 20th, and parents are welcome from two o'clock. Homework will be lighter that week so pupils can rest and prepare; the school also thanks the parent group for donating twenty new books to each classroom. Please remember that Friday is a teacher training day, so there will be no lessons.
options: Twenty New Books for Each Classroom
This Month's News from the School
quests.correctAnswer: This Month's News from the School
quests.hint: This is one of several items in a newsletter. What covers them all?
quests.explanation: Each distractor names a single item. A newsletter paragraph like this one gathers several announcements together.
quests.whyThisTitle: It covers the events, the thanks, and the reminder in one general school update.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Starting in July, the city will collect food waste weekly in brown bins, and general waste every two weeks. Residents will receive a free kitchen container and a supply of compostable bags; the change is intended to reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill. A leaflet with a collection calendar will be delivered to every household in June.
quests.correctAnswer: Weekly Food Waste Collection
quests.hint: Ask what service is being introduced and what supports it.
quests.explanation: Containers, the landfill aim, and the leaflet are all supporting information. The announcement is about the new collection arrangement.
quests.whyThisTitle: The title names the new service that the containers, bags, and leaflets are meant to support.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Before you begin assembling the desk, check that all parts on the list are present. Lay out the pieces on a soft surface to prevent scratches. Start with the frame, tightening screws only halfway, then fit the top and tighten everything at the end. Two people are recommended for the final lift into position. If a part is missing, contact us with the code printed on the box.
options: Contacting the Company About Missing Parts
Assembling a Desk Step by Step
quests.correctAnswer: Assembling a Desk Step by Step
quests.hint: Check whether the passage follows a sequence and how far it goes.
quests.explanation: Scratches, lifting, and missing parts are each one instruction. The text presents the whole assembly process in order.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title follows the process from checking parts to final positioning.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Dear Mr. Silva, thank you for meeting with me on Tuesday to discuss the marketing assistant position. I enjoyed learning about your plans for the new campaign, and our conversation confirmed my interest in the role. I have attached the sample report I mentioned. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to hearing from you.
options: A Thank-You Email After a Job Interview
Confirming Interest in the Marketing Role
quests.correctAnswer: A Thank-You Email After a Job Interview
quests.hint: Ask what kind of message this is and what occasion prompted it.
quests.explanation: The sample report, the campaign, and the interest in the role are all mentioned. The email is a follow-up after the meeting.
quests.whyThisTitle: This choice names the email's purpose: thanking the interviewer and keeping the candidate's application on record.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: From January, bus and tram fares will be capped at five dollars a day. Passengers who tap their cards will pay as usual until they reach the cap, after which all further trips that day are free. Paper tickets will not be included, so regular travelers are encouraged to switch to a card. The city says the change is meant to help people who take several trips a day.
options: A Daily Cap on Transport Fares
Free Trips After the Cap Is Reached
Switching from Paper Tickets to Cards
quests.correctAnswer: A Daily Cap on Transport Fares
quests.hint: Ask what the new policy is, and what the other titles say about it.
quests.explanation: Paper tickets, free later trips, and frequent travelers are all details of the policy. The announcement's main news is the cap itself.
quests.whyThisTitle: The best title states the policy that the card rule, free trips, and purpose all explain.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Trail closure notice: the Ridge Path between the parking lot and the summit is closed until further notice because of a landslide after last week's rain. Hikers may still use the lower Valley Path, which is fully open. Rangers are inspecting the damage and expect to reopen the Ridge Path by the end of the month. Please do not cross the barriers, as the ground remains unstable.
options: Ridge Path Closed with Valley Path Open
Unstable Ground Beyond the Rangers' Barriers
quests.correctAnswer: Ridge Path Closed with Valley Path Open
quests.hint: What does a hiker need to know from this notice?
quests.explanation: The landslide and the unstable ground explain the closure. Walking the Valley Path is only half of what hikers need to know.
quests.whyThisTitle: It states both the closed route and the open alternative.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Students leaving the residence at the end of term should book a check-out slot online by the 10th. On the day, remove all belongings, clean the kitchen and bathroom, and return your key to the front desk. A staff member will inspect the room and, if everything is in order, confirm the return of your deposit within two weeks. Items left behind will be donated to charity.
options: Getting Your Deposit Back Within Two Weeks
How to Check Out of a Student Residence
quests.correctAnswer: How to Check Out of a Student Residence
quests.hint: Follow the tasks in the order they are described.
quests.explanation: The deposit, the cleaning, and the donations are all part of the process. The text describes the whole check-out sequence.
quests.whyThisTitle: The title covers booking, cleaning, key return, and inspection as one process.

quests.instruction: Drag the best title for the passage.
quests.passage: Dear customer, we apologize that your order has not yet arrived. A delay at our warehouse means it will now ship on Friday and arrive early next week. To make up for the wait, we have added a discount to your account, which you can use on your next order. You can track your parcel at any time using the link below. Thank you for your understanding.
options: An Apology and Update About a Late Order
A Discount for Your Next Purchase
quests.correctAnswer: An Apology and Update About a Late Order
quests.hint: Ask what the company is doing in this message beyond giving news.
quests.explanation: The discount, the tracking, and the warehouse problem are each one element. The message both apologizes and updates the customer.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title combines the apology with the new delivery date and the compensation.
